description: This source file defines the ExceptionPatcher class, which processes call graphs stored in Redis, enriches them with GitHub context, identifies exception propagation sequences, fetches detailed exception context, and generates prompts for AI-based code fixes and pull requests.

classes.name: ExceptionPatcher
classes.description: A class responsible for processing call graphs, identifying exception propagation sequences, enriching data with GitHub context, and generating AI prompts for code fixes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ExceptionPatcher with Redis client and repository URL, setting up helpers.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method that builds graphs from Redis, enriches with GitHub context, identifies exception sequences, fetches context, generates prompts, and interacts with GPT and repo helpers.

methods.name: extract_json_simple
methods.description: Extracts JSON substring from GPT response text.

methods.name: build_graphs_from_redis
methods.description: Loads call graphs from Redis matching the repository URL pattern.

methods.name: enrich_graphs_with_github_context
methods.description: Enriches each call graph with GitHub context data.

methods.name: select_exception_sequences
methods.description: Identifies sequences of nodes involved in exception propagation within a call graph.

methods.name: fetch_exception_context
methods.description: Gathers detailed context for exception nodes, including parent and child function details.

methods.name: format_node_details
methods.description: Formats detailed information about a node, including function info, exceptions, code, and content.

methods.name: fetch_parents
methods.description: Recursively fetches parent nodes up to a specified depth.

methods.name: fetch_children
methods.description: Recursively fetches child nodes up to a specified depth.

methods.name: generate_fix_prompt_based_on_context
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt for AI to suggest code fixes based on exception context.
